items.headline: RBI maintains repo rate at 5.25% for fourth consecutive meeting
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has maintained its repo rate at 5.25% with a neutral stance, projecting real GDP growth at 6.9% and CPI inflation at 4.6% for the current fiscal year. Upside risks to inflation include high energy prices and potential El Niño conditions, though government fiscal prudence has helped absorb shocks.

items.headline: Indian equities poised for positive open on easing US rate hike fears
items.summary: Indian equities are expected to open positively, mirroring rallies in Asian and US markets, driven by reduced concerns over a potential US Federal Reserve interest rate hike. A Federal Reserve official signaled support for holding rates steady if inflation eases. However, elevated Brent crude prices and Middle East tensions remain a concern.

items.headline: Sterlite Technologies Q1 net profit surges nearly twenty-fold; Crisil upgrades credit rating
items.summary: Sterlite Technologies reported a robust first-quarter performance with net profit increasing significantly year-on-year, leading Crisil to upgrade the company's credit rating.

items.headline: Realty, Media, Private/PSU Bank, Financial Services, Metal sectors see gains; IT, FMCG, Auto, Pharma, Healthcare, Oil & Gas weak
items.summary: In the previous trading session, sectors like Realty, Media, Private Bank, PSU Bank, Financial Services, and Metal witnessed gains, with Nifty Realty advancing 2.58%. Meanwhile, IT, FMCG, Auto, Pharma, Healthcare, and Oil & Gas experienced weakness, with Nifty IT declining by 0.85%.
